message:
How many of each dish do you order?

Add the dishes on offer to your free Bridal Team guest list, and guests choose theirs when they RSVP. You see how many of each to order, and you can export a spreadsheet with every guest, dish and dietary need for your caterer.

Try it free: https://bridalteam.com/wedding-rsvp?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-28-noon-meal-counts
